original_evidence.text: | Hyperspace | https://github.com/hyperspacedev/hyperspace | Electron (React/TypeScript) | Y | Y (`autoUpdater.checkForUpdatesAndNotify()` runs unconditionally at startup — electron-updater's default background-download + install-on-quit behavior) | Y (electron-updater default: downloads update artifact in background and installs it automatically when the app next quits/relaunches) | https, electron-updater's default GitHub Releases provider (inferred from `package.json:7` `"repository": "https://github.com/hyperspacedev/hyperspace.git"`; no explicit `publish:` block found in `ebuild/standard.yml`, and `-p 'never'` in build scripts only suppresses publishing during the build step, not the runtime provider) | unknown (no code-signing certs/config evidence in repo; `ebuild/standard.yml` sets `dmg: {sign: false}` and calls `afterSign: desktop/notarize.js`, but actual release-time signing status can't be determined from source) | hash-from-manifest (electron-updater's documented default: SHA512 hash embedded in the auto-generated `latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml`/`latest-linux.yml` is compared against the downloaded artifact; optional Windows publisher-name check only applies if the binary is code-signed, which is unconfirmed here) | electron-updater default (SHA512 field in GitHub Releases `latest*.yml`); no custom verification key/logic implemented in app code | `package.json:43` `"electron-updater": "^4.3.1"`; `public/electron.js:14` `const { autoUpdater } = require("electron-updater");` and `public/electron.js:18` `autoUpdater.checkForUpdatesAndNotify();`.
